## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle Tang-dynasty commentary on the *Fànwǎng jīng* bodhisattva-precepts by **Fǎ Xiǎn** 法銑 ([法銑](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E9%8A%91)).

**Abstract**

Fǎ Xiǎn's commentary is one of the more compact Tang-period treatments of the *Fànwǎng* precepts. It draws on the major preceding commentaries ([智顗](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E9%A1%97) Zhìyǐ–[灌頂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%81%8C%E9%A0%82) Guàndǐng's *Púsàjiè yìshū* [KR6k0078](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0078), [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) Fǎzàng's *Fànwǎngjīng púsàjièběn shū* [KR6k0080](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0080)) while presenting a more summary exposition suited to instructional use.
